q1.explanationZh: nevertheless 副词“不过，仍然”，也可作连词“然而”，常用分号或逗号隔开。

q3.explanationZh: new + comer（来的人）= newcomer“新来的人”。

q4.explanationZh: news“新闻；消息”，是不可数名词，虽然以 s 结尾。

q5.explanationZh: news + agent（代理人）= newsagent“报刊经销人”。

q7.explanationZh: next 可作形容词、副词和介词，next to“与……相邻”。

q8.explanationZh: nice“好的；使人高兴的”，如 What a nice day!

q9.explanationZh: niece“侄女；外甥女”，对应男性是 nephew。

q10.explanationZh: nick + name = nickname“绰号”，也可作动词“给……起绰号”。

q12.explanationZh: no 作副词“不”，作形容词“没有的”，如 no regrets。

q13.explanationZh: noble“高贵的；高尚的”，注意结尾是 -ble。

q14.explanationZh: no + body = nobody“没有人”，作主语时谓语用单数。

q15.explanationZh: nod“点头”，过去式 nodded，要双写 d。

q17.explanationZh: noise 去 e 加 y 构成形容词 noisy“嘈杂的”。

q18.explanationZh: none“没有一人；没有一个”，常用 none of ...。

q19.explanationZh: non-（非）+ fiction（小说）= nonfiction“非虚构作品”。

q20.explanationZh: non-（非）+ sense（意义）= nonsense“胡说，废话”。

q21.explanationZh: non-（不）+ stop = nonstop“不停的；直达的”。

q24.explanationZh: nor“也不”，常用 neither ... nor ...“既不……也不……”。

q28.explanationZh: north 加 -ern 构成形容词 northern“北方的”。

q32.explanationZh: New Year’s Day“元旦”，除夕是 New Year’s Eve。

q34.explanationZh: at night“在夜里”，介词用 at。

q35.explanationZh: 答案 a noble man 来自手册例句（意为“一个高尚的人”）；表示“贵族”时也常写作 nobleman。

q36.explanationZh: second to none 字面是“不比任何人差”，即“最好的”。

accept: It is normal for sb. to do
It's normal for sb. to do
It is normal for sb to do
it is normal for sb. to do sth.

q38.explanationZh: It is normal for sb. to do“某人做……是正常的”，it 是形式主语。

q39.explanationZh: at noon“在中午”，介词用 at。

q41.explanationZh: no sense“没有意义”，如 There is no sense in doing sth.。

q42.explanationZh: too ... to ...“太……而不能……”，noisy 放在 too 后面。

q43.explanationZh: none of us“我们中间没人”，见手册例句 None of us enjoy getting up early.

q44.explanationZh: make noise“制造噪音”，手册例句 make much noise。

q45.explanationZh: the next one“下一个”，next 前常加 the。

accept: there is a good news that ...
there is a good news that …
there is a good news that

q46.explanationZh: news 是不可数名词，规范写法是 There is good news that ...（同位语从句）；答案书印作 a good news。

q47.explanationZh: 前后两句意思相反（累了却继续工作），用 nevertheless“然而，仍然”。

q48.explanationZh: the whole nation“整个国家”，全国人民都沉浸在悲痛中。

q49.explanationZh: 《21世纪报》是一份报纸，What a + 形容词 + 单数名词，填 newspaper。

q50.explanationZh: Joyce 是女孩名，“我的侄女”用 niece。

q51.explanationZh: “什么都没说，只是点头”，said nothing“什么也没说”。

q52.explanationZh: “噪音也是一种污染”，noise 作主语，句首大写。

q53.explanationZh: “我喜欢读纪实作品”，答案书给 nonfictions；nonfiction 一般作不可数名词，写 nonfiction 也通。

q54.explanationZh: some 后接复数，面条常用复数 noodles。

q55.explanationZh: 后面有 nor，构成 neither ... nor ...“既不……也不……”。

q56.explanationZh: 修饰名词 cities 用形容词 northern“北方的”。

q57.sampleAnswer: Nowadays, what people are concerned about is not how to fill their stomachs but how to prevent themselves from gaining weight.
references: Nowadays, what people are concerned about is not how to fill their stomachs but how to prevent themselves from gaining weight.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q57.explanationZh: “不是……而是……”= not ... but ...；what 引导主语从句“人们担心的”。

q58.sampleAnswer: It would nevertheless affect our international position profoundly.
references: It would nevertheless affect our international position profoundly.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q58.explanationZh: “依旧，仍然”= nevertheless，放在情态动词 would 之后。

q59.sampleAnswer: The girl is so clever that she can memorize all these new words quickly.
references: The girl is so clever that she can memorize all these new words quickly.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “很……以至于……”= so ... that ...；“新单词”= new words。

q60.sampleAnswer: It is harmful for the little child to watch too much TV every night.
references: It is harmful for the little child to watch too much TV every night.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “每天晚上”= every night；It is harmful for sb. to do sth.“做某事对某人有害”。

q61.sampleAnswer: Reflection after a failure will increase your chances of achieving success next time.
references: Reflection after a failure will increase your chances of achieving success next time.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “下次”= next time，不加介词；“获得成功”= achieve success。

q62.sampleAnswer: Only you can do such a thing, I'm sure, and nobody else has such an ability
references: Only you can do such a thing, I'm sure, and nobody else has such an ability

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “别人没有”= nobody else，作主语时谓语用单数 has。

q63.sampleAnswer: The newcomer is not used to the heavy traffic in big cities.
references: The newcomer is not used to the heavy traffic in big cities.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “初来乍到的人”= newcomer；“不习惯”= be not used to + 名词；“交通拥挤”= heavy traffic。

q64.sampleAnswer: No matter how long we are apart and how many difficulties we have to overcome, we are still a family with blood thicker than water.
references: No matter how long we are apart and how many difficulties we have to overcome, we are still a family with blood thicker than water.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “无论多久 / 多少”= no matter how long / how many，引导让步状语从句。

q65.sampleAnswer: Please be quiet. We are not allowed to make much noise in the reading room.
references: Please be quiet. We are not allowed to make much noise in the reading room.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “大声喧哗”= make much noise；“不允许”= be not allowed to do。

q66.sampleAnswer: Not until that moment did Henry realize that gone were the previous carefree days.
references: Not until that moment did Henry realize that gone were the previous carefree days.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “直到……才……”= not until ...，放句首时主句要部分倒装 did Henry realize。
